response.sql: WITH quantities AS (SELECT order_id, CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(product_quantity), '') AS REAL) AS quantity FROM Order_Items), overall AS (SELECT AVG(quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM quantities), per_order AS (SELECT order_id, AVG(quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM quantities GROUP BY order_id) SELECT p.order_id, p.avg_quantity AS order_avg_quantity, p.avg_quantity - o.avg_quantity AS difference_from_overall FROM per_order AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.avg_quantity IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (p.avg_quantity IS NULL), difference_from_overall DESC LIMIT 10
